_about: Published Mac Boltz numbers, read from the pages themselves on 2026-10-31 (raw HTML parsed). Minutes unless stated. Nothing here is MEASURED by us. Settings the pages do not state are listed as unstated.

chimerax_runtimes.url: https://www.rbvi.ucsf.edu/chimerax/data/boltz-apr2025/runtimes.html (the same rows, first number per cell, are in https://www.rbvi.ucsf.edu/chimerax/data/boltz-apr2025/boltz_help.html#runtimes)
chimerax_runtimes.software: Boltz 2.1.1 (the help page: July 9, 2025 source; runtimes.html: 'actually slightly newer July 8, 2025(?)'), Mac: no kernels, 32-bit precision, torch 2.9 per the help page
chimerax_runtimes.unstated: sampling steps; whether MSA time is included; seed; number of runs; MSA server cache state
chimerax_runtimes.stated: recycles default 3, samples default 1, ColabFold MSA server (api.colabfold.com), float16 option default false (Mac uses fp32), steering default false

b2.M1_16GB: fail (runtimes.html: 'fail b1' only; blank in the help table)

chimerax_pncc_workshop.input: NTCA dimer (PDB 9GQU, 2 x 222 aa) + 2 x DNA 31-mer CATTTTTATGTATCAGCTGATACATAAAAAT + AKG, structure AND affinity; Boltz 2.2 installed by ChimeraX daily build; text: about 2 min structure, 1 min affinity
chimerax_pncc_workshop.reported_results: confidence 0.93, pTM 0.95, ipTM 0.95, pLDDT 0.93; AKG affinity 7.3 uM, binding probability 0.78 (https://www.rbvi.ucsf.edu/chimerax/data/pncc-workshop-sep2025/ntca_dna.html)
chimerax_pncc_workshop.unstated: steps, seed, MSA accounting, run count

moleculedesk.url: https://www.moleculedesk.com/docs/models/boltz (and https://www.moleculedesk.com/docs/benchmarks, which carries only the RTX 3090 rows)
moleculedesk.text: Apple M3, 'The 115-residue example finished in about 88 s' (single statement, no run count; the 3090 rows say median of 3). Workload line: single protein chain, 115 residues, no MSA (examples/boltz/protein.yaml), 1 sample. Mac install: Novel-Therapeutics/boltz-community fork (MPS), Boltz 2.2.1.
moleculedesk.input_check: examples/boltz/protein.yaml is in https://github.com/pooriyapfn/moldesk (its guide says sourced from Boltz's upstream examples); the file read on 2026-10-31 is 117 residues with msa: empty and is identical to upstream examples/prot_no_msa.yaml (= our prot117), not 115
moleculedesk.unstated: RAM, steps, recycles, seed, whether the 88 s includes process start / model load

nvidia_nim_h100.url: https://docs.nvidia.com/nim/bionemo/boltz2/1.7.0/performance.html (tables headed 'Boltz2 v1.6.0'; page sha256 caa82bc918f0dcafdcb50cfd8418d37561914234f222f26fb3dca78abbe198a1 as read on 2026-11-02, rows re-checked against it)
nvidia_nim_h100.hardware: H100 80GB HBM3 (NVIDIA); 'OSS' = the open-source implementation as the page labels it (not defined further), 'TensorRT' = NIM
nvidia_nim_h100.undisclosed: sampling steps, recycles, number of samples, whether MSA / featurisation time is in the runtime, warm vs cold, whether the structure rows include the affinity module, seeds, run count, what ligand the affinity rows use
